translations.idiomatic: In rescript replies issued by the Empress Dowager, the opening read "I have read your memorial and noted its particulars," and the closing read "Your request should be granted" or "not granted."

sentences.zh: 初，丁謂定皇太后稱 “予”，中書與禮院參議，每下制令稱“予”，便殿處分稱“吾”。

translations.literal: At first, Ding Wei fixed the Empress Dowager's self-designation as "I" (yu); the Secretariat and the Board of Rites deliberated together: each time formal edicts and commands were issued down she was called "I" (yu); in dispositions from the convenience hall she was called "I" (wu).
translations.idiomatic: At first Ding Wei fixed the Empress Dowager's self-designation as yu ("I"); the Secretariat and Board of Rites debated the matter: in formal edicts and commands she was to use yu, but in informal dispositions from the convenience hall she was to use wu.

sentences.zh: 皇太后詔：“止稱‘吾’，與皇帝並御承明殿垂簾決事。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager decreed: "Use only 'I' (wu); together with the emperor hold court at the Chenming Hall behind the curtain to decide affairs."
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager decreed: "Use only wu ('I'); together with the emperor hold court at the Chenming Hall behind the curtain to decide affairs."

sentences.zh: ”百官表賀。

translations.literal: " The hundred officials submitted memorials of congratulation.
translations.idiomatic: " The hundred officials submitted memorials of congratulation.

sentences.zh: 英宗即位，輔臣請與皇太后權同聽政。

translations.literal: When Yingzong acceded, the chief ministers requested that he and the Empress Dowager jointly hold provisional authority to hear government affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Yingzong acceded, the chief ministers asked that he and the Empress Dowager jointly hold provisional authority to govern.

sentences.zh: 禮院議：自四月內東門小殿垂簾，兩府合班起居，以次奏事，非時召學士亦許至小殿。

translations.literal: The Board of Rites deliberated: from the fourth month, behind the curtain at the small hall of the Inner Eastern Gate; the Two Departments formed a combined rank for the audience salutation, reported business in order, and when summoned out of hours academicians were also permitted to come to the small hall.
translations.idiomatic: The Board of Rites decided: from the fourth month the Empress Dowager would hold court behind the curtain at the small hall of the Inner Eastern Gate; the Two Departments would salute in a combined formation, report business in turn, and when summoned at irregular hours academicians were also permitted to attend the small hall.

sentences.zh: 時帝以疾權居柔儀殿東閣西室，太后垂簾處分稱“吾”，唯兩府日入候問聖體，因奏政事，退詣小殿簾外，覆奏太后。

translations.literal: At the time, because of illness the emperor temporarily resided in the western chamber of the eastern pavilion of Rouyi Hall; the empress dowager, behind the curtain, issued dispositions calling herself "I" (wu); only the Two Departments entered each day to inquire after the imperial person and, in the course of doing so, reported government affairs; on withdrawing they went to outside the curtain of the small hall and reported again to the empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the emperor, ill, temporarily resided in the western chamber of the eastern pavilion of Rouyi Hall; the empress dowager issued dispositions from behind the curtain using wu ("I"); only the Two Departments entered daily to inquire after his health and report government affairs, then withdrew to outside the small hall's curtain and reported again to the empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 帝疾間，御前後殿聽政，兩府退朝，猶於小殿覆奏。

translations.literal: When the emperor's illness eased, he held court and heard government affairs in the front and rear halls; when the Two Departments withdrew from court, they still reported again at the small hall.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor's illness eased, he held court in the front and rear halls; after the Two Departments withdrew from court, they still reported again at the small hall.

sentences.zh: 哲宗即位，太皇太后權同聽政。

translations.literal: When Zhezong acceded, the Grand Empress Dowager held provisional authority to hear government affairs jointly with him.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhezong acceded, the Grand Empress Dowager held provisional joint authority to govern.

sentences.zh: 三省、樞密院按儀注：未釋服以前，遇隻日皇帝御迎陽門，日參官並赴起居，依例奏事。

translations.literal: The Three Departments and the Military Affairs Commission followed the ritual protocol: before mourning garments were laid aside, on odd-numbered days the emperor held court at the Yingyang Gate; daily-attending officials all came for the audience salutation and reported business according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Departments and Military Affairs Commission followed ritual protocol: before mourning dress ended, on odd-numbered days the emperor held court at the Yingyang Gate; daily-attending officials all came to salute and report business as usual.

sentences.zh: 每五日，遇隻日於迎陽門垂簾，皇帝坐於簾內之北，宰執奏事則權屏去左右侍衛；

translations.literal: Every five days, on an odd-numbered day court was held behind the curtain at the Yingyang Gate; the emperor sat at the north within the curtain; when chief ministers reported business, attendants left and right were temporarily dismissed;
translations.idiomatic: Every five days, on an odd-numbered day court was held behind the curtain at the Yingyang Gate; the emperor sat at the north within the curtain; when chief ministers reported business, attendants on either side were temporarily dismissed;

sentences.zh: 事有機速，許非時請對，及賜宣召，亦許升殿。

translations.literal: if business was urgent, unscheduled audiences were permitted, and when imperial summons was granted, ascending the hall was also permitted.
translations.idiomatic: if business was urgent, unscheduled audiences were permitted, and when summoned by imperial decree, officials were also permitted to ascend the hall.

sentences.zh: 禮部、御史台、閣門奏討論御殿及垂簾儀制，每朔、望、六參，皇帝御前殿，百官起居，三省、樞密院奏事，應見、謝、辭班退，各令詣內東門進榜子。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites, Censorate, and Pavilion Gate memorialized requesting discussion of the protocol for holding court in the main hall and behind the curtain: on each new moon, full moon, and six-attendance day the emperor held court in the front hall; the hundred officials performed the audience salutation; the Three Departments and Military Affairs Commission reported business; when audience, thanksgiving, and farewell ranks withdrew, each was directed to proceed to the Inner Eastern Gate and submit a petition slip.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites, Censorate, and Pavilion Gate memorialized to discuss protocol for main-hall court and curtain audience: on new-moon, full-moon, and six-attendance days the emperor held court in the front hall; the hundred officials saluted; the Three Departments and Military Affairs Commission reported business; and when audience, thanksgiving, and farewell ranks withdrew, each was directed to the Inner Eastern Gate to submit a petition slip.

sentences.zh: 皇帝隻日御延和殿垂簾，日參官起居太皇太后，移班少西起居皇帝，並再拜。

translations.literal: On odd-numbered days the emperor held court behind the curtain at the Yanhe Hall; daily-attending officials saluted the Grand Empress Dowager, then shifted their ranks slightly westward to salute the emperor; all bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: On odd-numbered days the emperor held court behind the curtain at the Yanhe Hall; daily-attending officials saluted the Grand Empress Dowager, then shifted slightly west to salute the emperor; all bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 三省、樞密院奏事，三日以上四拜，不舞蹈，候祔廟畢，起居如常儀。

translations.literal: When the Three Departments and Military Affairs Commission reported business, for three days and more they bowed four times and did not perform the bow-and-dance; after spirit-tablet enshrinement in the ancestral temple was complete, the audience salutation followed the usual protocol.
translations.idiomatic: When the Three Departments and Military Affairs Commission reported business, for three days or more they bowed four times without the bow-and-dance; after enshrinement in the ancestral temple was complete, salutations followed the usual protocol.

sentences.zh: 簾前通事以內侍，殿下以閣門。

translations.literal: Before the curtain, protocol announcers were drawn from inner attendants; below the hall, from the Pavilion Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Before the curtain, protocol announcers were inner attendants; below the hall, they were Pavilion Gate officials.

sentences.zh: 吏部磨勘奏舉人，垂簾日引。

translations.literal: When the Ministry of Personnel reviewed and memorialized candidates, they were introduced on curtain-audience days.
translations.idiomatic: When the Ministry of Personnel reviewed and memorialized candidates, they were introduced on days when court was held behind the curtain.

sentences.zh: 應見、謝、辭臣僚遇朔、望參日不坐，並先詣殿門，次內東門，應抬賜者並門賜之。

translations.literal: Officials due for audience, thanksgiving, or farewell who encountered new-moon or full-moon attendance days did not take seats; all first proceeded to the hall gate, then to the Inner Eastern Gate; what should be granted by raised tray was all granted at the gate.
translations.idiomatic: Officials due for audience, thanksgiving, or farewell who encountered new-moon or full-moon attendance days did not take seats; all first went to the hall gate, then to the Inner Eastern Gate; items to be granted by raised tray were all granted at the gate.

sentences.zh: 於是帝御迎陽門幄殿，同太皇太后垂簾，宰臣、親王以下合班起居。

translations.literal: Thereupon the emperor held court at the pavilion hall of the Yingyang Gate and, together with the Grand Empress Dowager, held court behind the curtain; chief ministers, imperial princes, and those below formed a combined rank for the audience salutation.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the emperor held court at the pavilion hall of the Yingyang Gate and, together with the Grand Empress Dowager, held court behind the curtain; chief ministers, imperial princes, and those below saluted in a combined formation.

sentences.zh: 常制分班十六，至是合班，以閣門奏請故也。

translations.literal: Under regular protocol there were sixteen separate ranks; at this time they formed a combined rank, because the Pavilion Gate had memorialized requesting it.
translations.idiomatic: Under regular protocol there were sixteen separate ranks; on this occasion they formed a combined rank at the Pavilion Gate's request.

sentences.zh: 禮官請如有祥瑞、邊捷，宰臣以下紫宸殿稱賀皇帝畢，赴內東門賀太皇太后。

translations.literal: Ritual officials requested that if there were auspicious omens or frontier victories, after chief ministers and those below offered congratulations to the emperor at the Zichen Hall, they should proceed to the Inner Eastern Gate to congratulate the Grand Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials requested that when auspicious omens or frontier victories occurred, after chief ministers and those below congratulated the emperor at the Zichen Hall, they should proceed to the Inner Eastern Gate to congratulate the Grand Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 皇太子元正、冬至受群臣賀儀。

translations.literal: Rites for the crown prince to receive congratulations from the hundred officials on New Year's Day and the winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: Rites for the crown prince to receive congratulations from the assembled officials on New Year's Day and the winter solstice.

sentences.zh: 《政和新儀》：前一日，有司於東門外量地之宜，設三公以下文武群官等次如常儀；

translations.literal: New Rites of the Zhenghe Era: On the day before, the relevant offices, choosing suitable ground outside the eastern gate, set the ordered ranks of the Three Excellencies and below, civil and military officials together, according to the usual protocol;
translations.idiomatic: New Rites of the Zhenghe Era: On the day before, the relevant offices laid out suitable ground outside the eastern gate and set the ordered ranks of the Three Excellencies and below, civil and military officials together, according to usual protocol;

sentences.zh: 典儀設皇太子答拜褥位於階下，南向，又設文武群官版位於門之外。

translations.literal: The master of ceremonies set the crown prince's cushioned position for returning bows below the steps, facing south; he also set the name-tablet positions of civil and military officials outside the gate.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonies set the crown prince's cushioned station for returning bows below the steps, facing south, and set the name-tablet positions of civil and military officials outside the gate.

sentences.zh: 其日，禮直官、舍人先引三公以下文武群臣以次入，就位立定。

translations.literal: On that day, ritual attendants and protocol masters first led the Three Excellencies and below, civil and military officials, to enter in order, take their positions, and stand in place.
translations.idiomatic: On that day ritual attendants and protocol masters first led the Three Excellencies and below, civil and military officials, to enter in order and take their positions.

sentences.zh: 禮直官、舍人引左庶子詣皇太子前，跪請內嚴；

translations.literal: Ritual attendants and protocol masters led the Left Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent before the crown prince; he knelt and requested that the inner court be secured;
translations.idiomatic: Ritual attendants and protocol masters led the Left Junior Guardian before the crown prince; he knelt and requested that the inner court be secured;

sentences.zh: 少頃，又言外備。

translations.literal: after a short while, he again reported that the outer preparations were complete.
translations.idiomatic: after a short while he again reported that the outer preparations were complete.

sentences.zh: 內侍褰簾，皇太子常服出次，左右侍衛如常儀。

translations.literal: Inner attendants raised the curtain; the crown prince in ordinary dress emerged from the side chamber; attendants left and right were as in the usual protocol.
translations.idiomatic: Inner attendants raised the curtain; the crown prince in ordinary dress emerged from the side chamber with attendants left and right as usual.

sentences.zh: 皇太子降階詣南向褥位，典儀曰“再拜”，讚者承傳曰“再拜”，三公以下皆再拜，皇太子答拜。

translations.literal: The crown prince descended the steps and went to the south-facing cushioned position; the master of ceremonies said "Bow twice"; the announcer received and transmitted "Bow twice"; the Three Excellencies and below all bowed twice; the crown prince returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince descended the steps to the south-facing cushioned station; the master of ceremonies called "Bow twice"; the announcer echoed "Bow twice"; the Three Excellencies and below all bowed twice; the crown prince returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 班首少前稱賀云：“元正首祚

translations.literal: The head of the formation stepped slightly forward and offered congratulations, saying: "On New Year's Day, the year's first fortune
translations.idiomatic: The lead official stepped forward and offered congratulations: "On New Year's Day, the year's first fortune

sentences.zh: （冬至云“天正長至”）〉

translations.literal: (On the winter solstice say "On the winter solstice, when the celestial first day reaches its fullness")›
translations.idiomatic: (On the winter solstice say "On the winter solstice, when the celestial first day reaches its fullness")›

sentences.zh: ，景福維新。

translations.literal: , may glorious blessings renew themselves.
translations.idiomatic: , may splendid fortune be renewed.

sentences.zh: 伏惟皇太子殿下，與時同休。

translations.literal: We humbly pray that Your Highness the Crown Prince may share repose with the seasons.
translations.idiomatic: We humbly pray that Your Highness the Crown Prince may share repose with the times.

sentences.zh: ”賀訖，少退，復位。

translations.literal: " When congratulations were finished, he withdrew slightly and returned to position.
translations.idiomatic: " When congratulations were finished, he withdrew and returned to position.

sentences.zh: 左庶子前，承命詣群臣前答云：“元正首祚

translations.literal: The Left Junior Guardian advanced; receiving the command, he went before the assembled officials and replied, saying: "On New Year's Day, the year's first fortune
translations.idiomatic: The Left Junior Guardian advanced; receiving the command, he went before the assembled officials and replied: "On New Year's Day, the year's first fortune

sentences.zh: （冬至云“天正長至”）〉

translations.literal: (On the winter solstice say "On the winter solstice, when the celestial first day reaches its fullness")›
translations.idiomatic: (On the winter solstice say "On the winter solstice, when the celestial first day reaches its fullness")›

sentences.zh: ，與公等均慶。

translations.literal: , may we share the celebration equally with you, sirs.
translations.idiomatic: , may we share this celebration equally with you all.

sentences.zh: ”典儀曰“再拜”，班首以下皆再拜，皇太子答拜。

translations.literal: " The master of ceremonies said "Bow twice"; from the head of the formation downward all bowed twice; the crown prince returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: " The master of ceremonies called "Bow twice"; from the lead official downward all bowed twice; the crown prince returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 訖，禮直官、通事舍人引三公以下文武百官以次出，內侍引皇太子升階，還次，降簾，侍衛如常儀。

translations.literal: When finished, ritual attendants and protocol masters led the Three Excellencies and below, civil and military officials, to withdraw in order; inner attendants led the crown prince to ascend the steps and return to the side chamber; the curtain was lowered; attendants were as in the usual protocol.
translations.idiomatic: When finished, ritual attendants and protocol masters led the Three Excellencies and below, civil and military officials, to withdraw in order; inner attendants led the crown prince up the steps and back to the side chamber; the curtain was lowered; attendants followed the usual protocol.

sentences.zh: 少頃，禮直官、舍人引知樞密院官以下入，就位立定，內侍引皇太子降階，詣南向褥位，樞密以下參賀如上儀。

translations.literal: After a short while, ritual attendants and protocol masters led the Director of the Military Affairs Commission and those below to enter, take their positions, and stand in place; inner attendants led the crown prince to descend the steps and go to the south-facing cushioned position; the Military Affairs Commission and those below offered congratulations according to the protocol above.
translations.idiomatic: After a short while ritual attendants and protocol masters led the Director of the Military Affairs Commission and those below to enter and take their positions; inner attendants led the crown prince down the steps to the south-facing cushioned station; the Military Affairs Commission and those below offered congratulations as above.

sentences.zh: 訖，退。

translations.literal: When finished, they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When finished, they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 次引師、傅、保、賓客以下入，就位，參賀如上儀。

translations.literal: Next they led the Preceptor, Tutor, Guardian, guests of honor, and those below to enter, take their positions, and offer congratulations according to the protocol above.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Preceptor, Tutor, Guardian, guests of honor, and those below were led in, took their positions, and offered congratulations as above.

sentences.zh: 師、傅、保以下以次出。

translations.literal: The Preceptor, Tutor, Guardian, and those below withdrew in order.
translations.idiomatic: The Preceptor, Tutor, Guardian, and those below withdrew in order.

sentences.zh: 內侍引皇太子升坐，禮直官引文武宮官入，就位，重行北向立，典儀曰“再拜”，在位官皆再拜。

translations.literal: Inner attendants led the crown prince to ascend and take his seat; ritual attendants led civil and military palace officials to enter, take their positions, and stand in double rows facing north; the master of ceremonies said "Bow twice"; all officials in position bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: Inner attendants led the crown prince to his seat; ritual attendants led civil and military palace officials in to take their positions in double rows facing north; the master of ceremonies called "Bow twice"; all officials present bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 左庶子少前，跪言：“具官某言：元正首祚

translations.literal: The Left Junior Guardian stepped slightly forward, knelt, and said: "Such-and-such an official, So-and-so, says: On New Year's Day, the year's first fortune
translations.idiomatic: The Left Junior Guardian stepped forward, knelt, and said: "Such-and-such an official, So-and-so, says: On New Year's Day, the year's first fortune

sentences.zh: （冬至云“天正長至 ”）〉

translations.literal: (On the winter solstice say "On the winter solstice, when the celestial first day reaches its fullness")›
translations.idiomatic: (On the winter solstice say "On the winter solstice, when the celestial first day reaches its fullness")›

sentences.zh: ，伏惟皇太子殿下，與時同休。

translations.literal: , we humbly pray that Your Highness the Crown Prince may share repose with the seasons.
translations.idiomatic: , we humbly pray that Your Highness the Crown Prince may share repose with the times.

sentences.zh: ”俯伏，興，復位。

translations.literal: " He prostrated himself, rose, and returned to position.
translations.idiomatic: " He prostrated himself, rose, and returned to position.

sentences.zh: 典儀曰“再拜”，在位者皆再拜，分東西序立。

translations.literal: The master of ceremonies said "Bow twice"; all those in position bowed twice and divided to stand in order east and west.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonies called "Bow twice"; all present bowed twice and divided to stand in order east and west.

sentences.zh: 左庶子少前，跪言禮畢。

translations.literal: The Left Junior Guardian stepped slightly forward, knelt, and reported that the rite was finished.
translations.idiomatic: The Left Junior Guardian stepped forward, knelt, and reported that the rite was finished.

sentences.zh: 左右近侍降簾，皇太子降坐，宮官退，左右侍衛以次出。

translations.literal: Attendants left and right lowered the curtain; the crown prince descended from his seat; palace officials withdrew; attendants left and right withdrew in order.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants on either side lowered the curtain; the crown prince left his seat; palace officials withdrew; attendants withdrew in order.

sentences.zh: 皇太子與百官相見。

translations.literal: The crown prince's meeting with the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince's meeting with the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 至道元年，有司言：“百官見皇太子，自兩省五品、尚書省御史台四品、諸司三品以上皆答拜，餘悉受拜。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhidao, the relevant offices said: "When the hundred officials met the crown prince, from fifth rank in the Two Departments, fourth rank in the Department of State Affairs and Censorate, and third rank and above in the various offices—all returned bows; the rest all received bows.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhidao, the relevant offices reported: "When the hundred officials met the crown prince, officials of fifth rank in the Two Departments, fourth rank in the Department of State Affairs and Censorate, and third rank and above in the various offices all returned bows; all others received bows only.

sentences.zh: 宮官自左右庶子以下，悉用參見之儀。

translations.literal: Palace officials from the Left and Right Junior Guardians of the Heir Apparent downward all used the protocol for attending audience.
translations.idiomatic: Palace officials from the Left and Right Junior Guardians downward all followed the protocol for attending audience.

sentences.zh: 其宴會位在王公上。

translations.literal: At banquets his seat was above those of princes and dukes.
translations.idiomatic: At banquets his seat ranked above those of princes and dukes.

sentences.zh: 與師、傅、保相見。

translations.literal: Meeting with the Preceptor, Tutor, and Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Meeting with the Preceptor, Tutor, and Guardian.

sentences.zh: 《政和新儀》：前一日，所司設師、傅、保以下次與宮門外道，西南向；

translations.literal: New Rites of the Zhenghe Era: On the day before, the relevant offices set the positions of the Preceptor, Tutor, Guardian, and those below outside the palace gate on the road, facing southwest;
translations.idiomatic: New Rites of the Zhenghe Era: On the day before, the relevant offices set the positions of the Preceptor, Tutor, Guardian, and those below outside the palace gate on the road, facing southwest;

sentences.zh: 設軒架之樂於殿庭，近南，北向。

translations.literal: they set the framed bell-and-stone ensemble in the hall courtyard, near the south, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: they set the framed bell-and-stone ensemble in the hall courtyard near the south, facing north.

sentences.zh: 其日質明，諸衛率各勒所部屯門列仗，典謁設皇太子位於殿東階下西向，設師、傅、保位，於殿西階之西，三少位於傅、保之南稍卻，俱東向北上。

translations.literal: At dawn that day, commanders of the various guard units each mustered their detachments to garrison the gates and post guard; the master of audiences set the crown prince's position below the eastern steps of the hall, facing west; he set the positions of the Preceptor, Tutor, and Guardian west of the western steps of the hall; the Three Mentors' positions were slightly to the south of the Tutor and Guardian, all facing east and ascending northward.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn that day commanders of the various guard units mustered their detachments to garrison the gates and post guard; the master of audiences set the crown prince's position below the hall's eastern steps, facing west; he set the positions of the Preceptor, Tutor, and Guardian west of the western steps; the Three Mentors stood slightly south of the Tutor and Guardian, all facing east and ascending northward.

sentences.zh: 師、傅、保以下俱朝服至宮門，通事舍人引就次，左庶子請內嚴。

translations.literal: The Preceptor, Tutor, Guardian, and those below all came to the palace gate in court dress; protocol masters led them to their positions; the Left Junior Guardian requested that the inner court be secured.
translations.idiomatic: The Preceptor, Tutor, Guardian, and those below all came to the palace gate in court dress; protocol masters led them to their positions; the Left Junior Guardian requested that the inner court be secured.

sentences.zh: 通事舍人引師、傅、保立於正殿門之西，三少在其南稍卻，俱東向北上。

translations.literal: Protocol masters led the Preceptor, Tutor, and Guardian to stand west of the main hall gate; the Three Mentors were slightly to their south, all facing east and ascending northward.
translations.idiomatic: Protocol masters led the Preceptor, Tutor, and Guardian to stand west of the main hall gate; the Three Mentors stood slightly to their south, all facing east and ascending northward.

sentences.zh: 左庶子言外備，諸侍奉之官各服其器服，俱詣閣奉迎。

translations.literal: The Left Junior Guardian reported that the outer preparations were complete; each attending official put on his ceremonial regalia and all proceeded to the pavilion to receive him.
translations.idiomatic: The Left Junior Guardian reported that the outer preparations were complete; each attending official donned his ceremonial regalia and all proceeded to the pavilion to receive the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 皇太子朝服以出，左右侍衛如常儀，軒架作《翼安之樂》，至東階下西向立，樂止。

translations.literal: The crown prince in court dress came forth; attendants left and right were as in the usual protocol; the framed ensemble performed "Music of Winged Tranquility"; he reached below the eastern steps and stood facing west; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince came forth in court dress with attendants left and right as usual; the framed ensemble performed "Music of Winged Tranquility"; he reached below the eastern steps and stood facing west; the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 通事舍人引師、傅、保及三少入，就位，軒架作《正安之樂》，至位樂止。

translations.literal: Protocol masters led the Preceptor, Tutor, Guardian, and Three Mentors to enter and take their positions; the framed ensemble performed "Music of Correct Tranquility"; when they reached their positions the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Protocol masters led the Preceptor, Tutor, Guardian, and Three Mentors in to take their positions; the framed ensemble performed "Music of Correct Tranquility"; when they reached their positions the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 皇太子再拜，師、傅、保以下答拜

translations.literal: The crown prince bowed twice; the Preceptor, Tutor, Guardian, and those below returned the bow
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince bowed twice; the Preceptor, Tutor, Guardian, and those below returned the bow

sentences.zh: （若三少特見，則三少先拜）〉

translations.literal: (If the Three Mentors were received separately, then the Three Mentors bowed first)›
translations.idiomatic: (If the Three Mentors were received separately, the Three Mentors bowed first)›

sentences.zh: 通事舍人引師、傅、保以下出，軒架《正安之樂》作，出門，樂止。

translations.literal: Protocol masters led the Preceptor, Tutor, Guardian, and those below to withdraw; the framed ensemble performed "Music of Correct Tranquility"; when they passed out the gate the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Protocol masters led the Preceptor, Tutor, Guardian, and those below out; the framed ensemble performed "Music of Correct Tranquility"; when they passed out the gate the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 左庶子前跪稱：“左庶子某言，禮畢。

translations.literal: The Left Junior Guardian advanced, knelt, and reported: "The Left Junior Guardian So-and-so says: The rite is finished.
translations.idiomatic: The Left Junior Guardian advanced, knelt, and reported: "The Left Junior Guardian So-and-so says: The rite is finished.

sentences.zh: ”皇太子入，左右侍衛及樂作如來儀。

translations.literal: " The crown prince entered; attendants left and right and the music were as when he had come forth.
translations.idiomatic: " The crown prince entered; attendants and music followed the same protocol as when he had come forth.
